title: 远东出口增长近6%：运价却要更温和？，马士基CEO怎么看
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Can I just very briefly summarize a view then from you?
segments.zh: 我能简单总结一下你的观点吗？

segments.en: I mean, push back if you want. But is your take then that freight rates higher for longer?
segments.zh: 如果你不同意可以反驳。你的看法是运费会长期保持高位吗？

segments.en: I think the freight rates will continue to be volatile. There have been very volatile the last six or seven years.
segments.zh: 我认为运费将继续波动。过去六七年里波动很大。

segments.en: They will continue to be volatile. But I think the general environment for the years to come will be more benign as long as the market continues
segments.zh: 它们将继续波动。但我认为，只要市场继续保持韧性，未来几年的整体环境会更温和。

segments.en: to be as resilient as it has been for the past few years.
segments.zh: 就像过去几年那样有韧性。

segments.en: Just because we are reaching some of these bottlenecks and we are starting to stretch the capacity and we're seeing more and more events here and there.
segments.zh: 因为我们正遇到一些瓶颈，产能开始紧张，各地事件频发。

segments.en: And certainly these disruptions will be more prevalent in the future.
segments.zh: 这些干扰未来肯定会更频繁。

segments.en: So yes, we're thinking that continued volatility, more benign environment and therefore a better outlook for the segment.
segments.zh: 所以，我们认为波动持续，环境更温和，因此行业前景更好。

segments.en: And you gave us some color on the China story with that weight of 12 days.
segments.zh: 你提到了中国的情况，有12天的延误。

segments.en: I think you said outside of Shanghai. What is the volume growth looking like for China going forward in the quarters ahead?
segments.zh: 你说的是上海以外。未来几个季度中国的货运量增长会怎样？

segments.en: Yes, so I mean, what we see outside the fact that demand is resilient is that demand is more and more coming for exports out of Asia.
segments.zh: 是的，除了需求韧性外，我们看到越来越多需求来自亚洲出口。

segments.en: We have a market that is growing for the year at about 4%.
But we have the farest market is growing just in the second quarter with the disruption of the Middle East has grown as close to 6% for export for the farest to the world.
segments.zh: 但远东市场在第二季度因中东干扰，出口增长接近6%。
